record.question: Open vial policy allows reuse of partially used multi dose vials of applicable vaccines under UIP in subsequent session. Which of the following vaccine follow this policy?
record.explanation: Answer D: IPV. India’s open-vial policy permits eligible liquid multidose IPV vials to be reused across sessions when conditions are met; reconstituted BCG and MR vaccines are excluded. Source/context note: Reuse is conditional on expiry, vial monitor, cold chain, aseptic handling, and national policy. Reference: https://www.nhm.gov.in/New_Updates_2018/NHM_Components/Immunization/Guildelines_for_immunization/Mission_Indradhanush_Guidelines.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
